name: Talkative
description_en:
Talkative supplies contact-centre AI and human support across digital chat,messaging,voice and video. Its newer Digital AI is a prompt-driven chatbot distinct from the traditional visual chatbot and its knowledge-base lookup node. Navi/Copilot assists staff rather than replacing every agent. Current public documentation marks Digital AI beta and web-only,so the platform’s omnichannel positioning should not be read as proof that this particular builder works on every channel.

For an illustrative service request,connect approved knowledge and a Queue Transfer tool,test an uncertain answer and a human request,then publish both the chatbot and its website widget. Resource limits can stop incoming conversations and phone access. Licensing can be interaction-based,named-user or concurrent,and the final quote matters more than a generic feature list. This is public-documentation research without an account,AI,widget,handoff,call,payment or export test.
description_zh:
Talkative 面向联络中心提供跨数字聊天、消息、语音及视频的 AI 与真人支持。较新 Digital AI 是提示驱动机器人，区别于传统可视机器人及其知识库查询节点。Navi／Copilot 辅助人员，不是取代所有客服。当前文档将 Digital AI 标为 beta 且仅限网页，平台全渠道定位不证明该具体构建器可用全部渠道。

以假设服务请求为例，连接批准知识及 Queue Transfer 工具，测试不确定答案与要真人的请求，然后同时发布机器人和网站组件。资源上限可阻断新会话及电话接入。授权可能按交互、实名用户或并发计，最终报价比通用功能清单更重要。本稿为公开文档研究，未测试账号、AI、组件、交接、电话、支付或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure instructions and explicit tools in the beta web-chat builder;traditional decision-tree bots remain separate.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在 beta 网页聊天构建器配置指令及明确工具，传统决策树机器人仍独立。

core_features.explanation_en: Knowledge Base Search retrieves approved content and Queue Transfer enables human escalation when configured.
core_features.explanation_zh: Knowledge Base Search 检索批准内容，配置 Queue Transfer 后可升级真人。

core_features.explanation_en: Interaction,named-user and concurrent licensing have different user and usage constraints.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按交互、实名用户及并发授权，对用户及用量的约束不同。

core_features.explanation_en: Use a default-off overage permission plus per-channel and global ceilings;charges accrue separately.
core_features.explanation_zh: 需默认关闭的超额许可加渠道及全局上限，额外费用另计。

en: Contact centres maintaining knowledge,staff queues and formal AI rollout testing.
A limited web-chat DigitalAI pilot alongside an existing controlled decision-tree bot.
zh: 维护知识、人员队列及正式 AI 推进测试的联络中心。
在既有可控决策树机器人旁开展小范围网页 Digital AI 试点。
use_cases.basis: Editorial scenarios,not measured containment,CSAT or revenue.

Double publication.en: Publishing Digital AI does not expose it to customers. Add it to the selected Chat Widget and publish that widget too.
Double publication.zh: 发布 Digital AI 不会直接面向客户，还需加入选定 Chat Widget 并发布该组件。

steps.en: Obtain an account-specific quote identifying interaction/named/concurrent licensing,channel availability,all allowances and hard-stop/overage rules.
steps.zh: 取得账户报价，明确交互／实名／并发授权、渠道、全部额度及硬停／超额规则。

steps.en: Create the Digital AI prompt,connect Knowledge Base Search and Queue Transfer,then preview missing knowledge,wrong URLs and absent agents.
steps.zh: 创建 Digital AI 提示、连接 Knowledge Base Search 与 Queue Transfer，再预览知识缺失、错误链接及无人接待。

steps.en: Publish the tested bot and widget,verify resource caps and establish a phone fallback before live traffic.
steps.zh: 发布已测机器人及组件，核对资源上限，并在真实流量前建立电话回退。

items.en: Digital AI is beta and web-only in its guide;platform-wide messaging/voice marketing is a broader scope.
items.zh: 指南中 Digital AI 为 beta 且网页限定，平台消息／语音营销是更大范围。

items.en: At total conversation cap,new web chats/transfers can be blocked;at voice-minute cap,the phone line disconnects.
items.zh: 总会话满额可阻止新网页聊天／转接，语音分钟用完可导致电话断线。

items.en: Enabling overage alone does not allow extra traffic;per-channel and global limits must also permit it.
items.zh: 只打开超额开关不允许额外流量，渠道及全局上限也必须允许。

items.en: Region and provider retention differ by feature and documentation;no universal local-only or zero-retention guarantee was established.
items.zh: 区域及提供商留存按功能和文档不同，未建立通用仅本地或零留存保证。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 公开2026CS美元符号报价 Pro 年付折月750或月付850，Advanced 年付1500或月付1800，Enterprise询价。标题 Pro 每月250数字会话／1000语音分钟，Advanced1000／4000。另一个Limits表写500／2000会话及1000／10000语音分钟，需澄清。POC与销售商议，无固定免费试用，注册开始计费。超额按合同且默认关闭，税另计，未用期间通常不退。

faq.question_en: Does publishing the bot put it on the website?
faq.question_zh: 发布机器人就会显示网站吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The guide requires adding the Digital AI to a Chat Widget and publishing the widget as a separate step.
faq.answer_zh: 不会。指南要求另外将 Digital AI 加到 Chat Widget 并发布组件。

faq.question_en: Is a closed account the same as canceled renewal?
faq.question_zh: 关闭账户是否等于取消续费？
faq.answer_en: No. Terms explicitly say closing access does not end the contractual term or automatic renewals. Default service-ending notice is30days in writing,subject to the contract.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。条款明确关闭访问不终止合同期或自动续费，默认结束服务需书面提前30天，具体看合同。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Digital AI is one part of a wider contact-centre platform
sections.title_zh: Digital AI 是更广联络中心平台的一部分
sections.en:
Talkative combines AI automation with human chat,messaging,phone and video capabilities. A contact-centre integration,queue and staffed handover are operational dependencies,not supplied human labour. Vendor containment,CSAT and revenue claims were not independently verified. The platform menu also includes training,analytics and Navi/Copilot;those features have separate configuration and usage implications.

The Digital AI guide describes a beta web-chat feature driven by one main prompt,with instructions deciding conversational flow. Traditional chatbots remain available:their visual tree can use an AI lookup node,but that node cannot choose a new branch based on conversation in the same way. Choose the traditional model when a precise controlled flow or clickable chips is essential. An omnichannel platform headline does not remove the newer builder’s documented web-only restriction.
sections.zh:
Talkative 结合 AI 自动化与真人聊天、消息、电话、视频。联络中心集成、队列及有值守交接是运营依赖，不是供应真人劳力。厂商围堵率、CSAT 及营收主张未独立核实。菜单还有训练、分析及 Navi／Copilot，各有配置和用量影响。

Digital AI 指南描述由一个主提示驱动的 beta 网页聊天功能，以指令决定会话流程。传统机器人仍可用，其可视树可加 AI 查询节点，但该节点不能以同样方式按会话选择新分支。需要严格受控流程或点击 chips 时可选传统模式。平台全渠道标题不会解除较新构建器文档中的网页限制。

sections.title_zh: 连接工具并完成两次发布
sections.en:
For an illustrative service enquiry,define the bot’s role,what it may answer,what information it must collect,and when to stop and call a human. Add Knowledge Base Search for approved content and Queue Transfer for real escalation. A sentence such as “I will transfer you” without the transfer tool is not sufficient. The knowledge base supplies content;the main prompt controls behaviour. The AI explainer says content is retrieved in chunks and the model does not automatically learn from live conversations.

Preview a normal question,missing information,a fabricated-link temptation and a direct human request. The guide cautions that language models can invent plausible URLs;test that links come from approved sources. Publishing the chatbot saves it but does not make it appear on the website. Add it to the selected Chat Widget and publish the widget too. Confirm the actual visitor path and queue destination after both steps. A saved prompt or a successful preview does not prove a deployed handover.
sections.zh:
以假设服务咨询为例，定义机器人角色、可答范围、需采资料及何时停下交真人。加 Knowledge Base Search 取批准内容，用 Queue Transfer 做真正升级。没有转接工具而只说“我将转接”并不足够。知识库供应内容，主提示控制行为。AI解释文档称按片段检索，模型不自动从真实会话学习。

预览正常问题、资料缺失、诱导造链接及明确要真人。指南提醒语言模型能编造似真 URL，需测试链接来自批准来源。发布机器人只是保存，不使它自动出现在网站；还需加入选定 Chat Widget 并发布组件。两步后确认真实访客路径及队列目的地，保存提示或预览成功不证明已部署交接。

sections.title_en: Different resource caps produce different customer failures
sections.title_zh: 不同资源上限带来不同客户失败
sections.en:
The licensing guide distinguishes interaction-based pricing from named-user seats and concurrent licenses. Interaction licensing allows unrestricted created users;named users consume licenses regardless of activity;concurrent licensing caps simultaneously active users. A sales quote must identify which applies. Total conversations and AI interactions are also different counters. A bot followed by agent assist in the same conversation counts as one AI interaction in the guide;passive summaries,rephrasing,alerts and sentiment are excluded.

When the total conversation cap is reached,the web widget can error and prevent new chats or transfers. When the AI-only limit is hit,new conversations cannot run AI,including knowledge lookups. Voice AI or Voice Assist minute exhaustion can make the phone line return a disconnect tone. The guide lists further fallback development as a future item,so no automatic graceful phone fallback is assumed. Knowledge test and insights quotas can separately stop those functions.

The guide’s fair-usage AI tokens are not billed token resources,but exhausting them can stop background features. Its alert thresholds50/75/97differ from the rate-page FAQ50/90. Do not build a critical staffing plan around a precise alert threshold or an assumed uninterrupted handover. Verify actual counters and fallback with the account’s CSM.
sections.zh:
授权指南区分按交互、实名座席及并发授权。交互模式不限制创建用户，实名用户不论活跃都占授权，并发模式限制同时活跃人数。报价需明确适用哪种。总会话与 AI 交互也是不同计数，指南中同会话机器人再到真人 AI 辅助仍算1次 AI 交互，纯摘要、改写、提醒及情绪分析不计。

总会话满额时，网页组件可报错并阻止新聊天或转接；仅 AI 额度用尽时，新会话不能运行 AI，包括知识查询。Voice AI 或 Voice Assist 分钟耗尽可使电话返回断线音。指南将更多回退开发列为未来事项，因此不能假设自动优雅电话回退。知识测试和洞察额度也可单独阻止功能。

指南中 AI 公平使用 token 不是计费 token 资源，但耗尽可能停止后台功能。其50／75／97提醒阈值与报价页FAQ50／90不同。不能围绕准确阈值或假定交接不中断安排关键值守，需和账户 CSM 核对真实计数及回退。

sections.title_en: Overage needs permission and two levels of limits
sections.title_zh: 超额需要许可及两层上限
sections.en:
The self-service overage guide resets usage on the first of each calendar month,including accounts that subscribed mid-month. Standard conversation allowance is pooled across channels,even though reporting shows individual channel usage. One bot-to-human interaction remains one conversation,and a fifteen-message SMS exchange is not automatically fifteen charges. Exact session termination and provider-message costs were not established.

Overage is off by default. Turning it on alone does not increase capacity:the account holder must also raise channel limits and the global ceiling. The global maximum bounds all channels together. A team can stop new web contacts while allowing paid SMS/WhatsApp overage,but only within those settings. Extra interactions are billed at month end at the contract rate. Enterprise accounts may be handled through a CSM or channel partner rather than identical self-service controls. Test caps before a traffic spike;an enable switch is not a substitute for a budget and a human fallback.
sections.zh:
自助超额指南每月1日重置用量，包括月中订阅账户。标准会话额度跨渠道共用，即使报告按渠道显示。一次机器人转真人仍是1会话，15条来回 SMS 不自动算15次。准确会话结束及提供商逐消息费用未建立。

超额默认关闭，仅打开不增加容量，还需账户所有者提高渠道限制和全局上限，全局约束所有渠道合计。团队可停止新网页咨询而允许付费 SMS／WhatsApp 超额，但须符合这些配置。额外交互按合同单价月底计费。Enterprise 可能经 CSM 或渠道伙伴处理，不保证同样自助控制。流量激增前应测试上限；开关不能替代预算及真人回退。

sections.title_en: A separate public rate page is not a universal account quote
sections.title_zh: 独立公开价目页不等于通用账户报价
sections.en:
The homepage pricing link at /pricing redirected to a demo page during this review. A separate public /pricing-2026-cs page lists dollar-denominated Pro750/month annually or850monthly,and Advanced1,500annually or1,800monthly,with Enterprise quoted. The headline allowances are250/1,000digital conversations and1,000/4,000voice minutes monthly. This is a dated public rate observation;currency code,tax and current account applicability were not independently confirmed.

The same page has another Limits section listing500/2,000conversations and1,000/10,000voice minutes. Total versus AI-specific conversation counters may explain part of that difference,but the page does not make all entitlement mapping clear. Its knowledge table lists20/50MB and manual/weekly refresh,with Enterprise daily/custom entries. Obtain one written allowance set rather than combining the most generous values across tables.

The page says billing begins at signup and proof-of-concept access is discussed with sales;it is not a fixed no-card free trial promise. Tool integrations vary between DIY and assisted,and CRM/contact-centre integrations can be paid extras. Terms generally do not refund an unused period and allow commercial details through approved partners. Final cost therefore depends on license model,usage,overage,integrations and contract,not just the first visible monthly amount.
sections.zh:
此次首页 /pricing 链接跳转演示页面。另一个公开 /pricing-2026-cs 页列美元符号报价：Pro 年付折月750或月付850，Advanced 年付1,500或月付1,800，Enterprise询价。标题额度每月250／1,000数字会话、1,000／4,000语音分钟。这是有日期公开观察，币种代码、税及当前账户适用性未独立确认。

同页另一个 Limits 部分列500／2,000会话及1,000／10,000语音分钟。总会话与仅 AI 计数可能解释部分差别，但页面没有澄清全部权益映射。知识表列20／50MB及手动／每周刷新，Enterprise 有每日／定制项。应取一份书面统一额度，不能跨表拼最宽松值。

页面称注册即开始计费，POC与销售商议，不是固定无卡免费试用承诺。工具集成有自行与协助区别，CRM／联络中心集成可能另收费。条款通常不退未用期间费用，并允许授权伙伴约定商业细节。因此最终费用取决授权模式、用量、超额、集成及合同，而非首个可见月金额。

sections.title_en: Model choice and closing access do not settle data or renewal
sections.title_zh: 选择模型与关闭访问不解决资料或续费问题
sections.en:
The Digital AI guide places GPT-4.1 processing for EU tenant domains in the EU and US/Australian tenant domains in the US. The broader AI explainer instead describes GPT-4.1 as US-hosted with30-day default retention,and other models as regionally hosted with zero-retention options. These are feature/configuration-specific vendor descriptions;they do not establish a uniform zero-retention or local-only deployment. The no-training statement is not a complete provider DPA,subprocessor or storage audit.

Terms describe proprietary business SaaS and retain vendor intellectual property. Closing the account removes login access but explicitly does not end the contractual term or automatic renewal;default termination notice is30days in writing unless the contract differs. No complete export,attachment restore or post-close retrieval guarantee was established. The terms’ reasonable-effort backup restoration remedy is not proof of a customer-tested recovery.

Talkative fits a contact centre able to maintain knowledge,prompts,queues,staff and usage governance. A buyer requiring deterministic approvals,unattended critical phone coverage or a uniform data-processing region should resolve those requirements before adoption. This draft does not validate security certifications,measured containment or a production deployment.
sections.zh:
Digital AI 指南将 EU 租户域的 GPT-4.1 处理放在 EU，将美国／澳大利亚租户域放美国。较广 AI解释则称 GPT-4.1 默认美国托管留存30天，其他模型有区域及零留存选择。这些是具体功能／配置的厂商说明，不建立统一零留存或仅本地部署。不训练主张也不等于完整提供商 DPA、子处理者或存储审计。

条款描述专有企业 SaaS并保留厂商知识产权。关闭账号移除登录，但明确不终止合同期或自动续费，默认结束服务需书面提前30天，具体合同可异。未建立完整导出、附件恢复或关闭后取回保证。条款合理努力从备份恢复的救济，不是客户实测恢复证明。

Talkative 适合能维护知识、提示、队列、人员及用量管理的联络中心。要求确定性批准、无值守关键电话覆盖或统一处理区域的买家，应先解决这些需求。本稿不验证安全认证、实测围堵率或生产部署。
